name: RulZ Level Up Tracker
tagline: See how long it will take to reach your next level.
description: Watches the rate you earn XP and estimates the time to your next level. Switch the estimate between the past hour, this session, your current level and all time.
features: Time to level and an estimated finish time
Allows for rested XP and pauses while you're AFK
Same-level kills and quests left to level, counted separately
Level-up summaries and a history of every level
Compact bar mode, lock, size slider and an in-game settings page
